limits: speedscope sampled weights have no per-sample absolute wall times; cannot precisely crop to requests
idle and waiting stacks included; weights are not CPU seconds or communication duration
nonblocking may produce partial stacks; no native attribution or per-request attribution
proc ticks are time-windowed per process and leader thread, not per Python function
No successful worker Python stack file was produced; proc readings cannot supply per-function samples.
SSE line timing is output-delivery granularity, not token-level TPOT, model-step latency or server serialization cost.
Recorded scope inclusive/exclusive walls are not CPU-active work or removable time; cross-rank sums do not yield request latency.

Engine CPU run, worker validation run and official profiling run are distinct observations and remain separate.
Name aggregates query all recorded names, not only TopN; names alone do not identify metadata fields, aliases or opportunities.
